product_summary: A foundational e-commerce website enabling users to browse a catalog of products, view their details, and add selected items to a shopping cart for potential future purchase.
problem_statement: Online shoppers require a straightforward and intuitive platform to discover products and compile a list of desired items without immediate commitment to purchase, streamlining the initial selection process.
target_users: Customers looking to build a shopping list
success_metrics: Number of unique product views per session
Percentage of products added to cart after viewing details
Average number of items in cart per user session

features.name: Product Listing Page
features.description: Displays a catalog of all available products with essential information.
acceptance_criteria: Each product shows name, price, and a thumbnail image
Products are displayed in a clear, scrollable format

features.name: Product Detail Page
features.description: Provides comprehensive information for a single product.
acceptance_criteria: Displays product name, detailed description, price, and multiple images
Users can navigate to this page from the product listing

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Allows users to collect products they wish to purchase.
acceptance_criteria: Users can add products from the product detail page to the cart
The cart displays a list of added products with their quantities and subtotal
Users can adjust the quantity of items in the cart
Users can remove items from the cart
The cart icon/indicator shows the number of items currently in the cart

user_flows.name: Browse Products and Add to Cart
steps: Shopper lands on the homepage/product listing page.
Shopper scrolls through the list of products.
Shopper clicks on a product to view its details.
Shopper reviews product details (description, price, images).
System confirms item added to cart (e.g., cart icon updates).
Shopper can continue browsing or view the cart.

modules.name: Product Catalog Service
modules.responsibility: Manages all product information, including details, images, and availability.

modules.name: Frontend UI
modules.responsibility: Renders the user interface for product browsing and cart management.

expected_scale: 100 concurrent users at launch, 10k daily active users within 6 months

data_entities.name: Product
data_entities.description: Represents an item available for sale.

data_entities.name: CartItem
data_entities.description: Represents a single product within a user's shopping cart.

possible_apis.description: Retrieve a list of all available products.
Retrieve details for a specific product.
Add a product to the current user's shopping cart.
Retrieve the current user's shopping cart contents.
Update the quantity of an item in the shopping cart.
Remove an item from the shopping cart.

functional_requirements: The system shall display a list of all available products.
The system shall allow users to view detailed information for each product, including name, description, price, and images.
The system shall allow users to add a specified quantity of a product to their shopping cart.
The system shall display the current contents of the user's shopping cart, including product name, quantity, and individual item price.
The system shall allow users to update the quantity of an item already in the shopping cart.
The system shall allow users to remove an item from the shopping cart.
The system shall provide a visual indicator (e.g., cart icon with item count) of the number of items in the cart.

non_functional_requirements.description: Product listing and detail pages should load within 3 seconds under normal network conditions.
The user interface for browsing products and managing the cart should be intuitive and easy to navigate.
The system should be able to handle an increasing number of products and concurrent users without significant performance degradation.
non_functional_requirements.target_metric: Supports 1000 concurrent users with < 5s response time

non_functional_requirements.description: The website should be available and functional 99.9% of the time.
User session data (e.g., cart contents) should be protected from unauthorized access.
non_functional_requirements.target_metric: No critical security vulnerabilities identified in penetration tests

constraints: Initial development will focus solely on product browsing and cart management; checkout and payment processing are out of scope for the MVP.
No user authentication or account management will be implemented in the initial phase; cart contents will be session-based.
Product data will be static or managed via a simple backend interface, not a full CMS.
assumptions: A source of product data (names, descriptions, prices, images, stock) will be provided.
Users will have a modern web browser and a stable internet connection.
The primary goal is to validate the core user journey of product discovery and cart population.
Session management for anonymous carts will be sufficient for the initial phase.
open_questions: What is the expected volume of products in the catalog?
Are there any specific design guidelines or branding requirements?
How will product images be hosted and managed?
What is the desired behavior for out-of-stock items?
